title: brisk host answers
description: Read by `brisk assess --answers file.json`. brisk recomputes the request and refuses answers whose request_id does not match.

model.description: Exact model version that answered, e.g. amp.ai.decide's result.model ("jev-1.14.0")

review_error.description: Why the harness's review call failed; recorded as provenance.review_plan status failed

review_usage.description: The review call's cost; brisk adds it to provenance.usage

review_answers.description: Optional answers to the request's review_questions. Missing or partial: the review plan is brisk's alone, not degraded.
